comment: The document says that only a subset of ArchiMate element and relationship types is used, but it does not explain the selection criteria or identify the excluded modelling concerns. Important areas such as business processes, roles, requirements, constraints, technology, and implementation sequencing appear later or are only partially represented.

anchor.note: p.42 l.Lines 56-62 read as the printed page; section 3.1 agrees

public.text: The document says that only a subset of ArchiMate element and relationship types is used, but it does not explain the selection criteria or identify the excluded modelling concerns. Important areas such as business processes, roles, requirements, constraints, technology, and implementation sequencing appear later or are only partially represented.
public.suggestedRevision: Explain why the selected subset is sufficient for the reference architecture’s scope. Identify additional ArchiMate constructs that country models may need for workflows, organisational responsibility, requirements, constraints, technology deployment, migration, and implementation planning.
